title: Islands to Bridges: Quarterly roadmap for Private/VPC maturity and ops unification
creator: Asha Menon
description: This initiative defines the quarterly roadmap that moves enterprise Private/VPC/on-prem customers from isolated deployment 'islands' toward a standardized 'bridges' model: consistent operational controls, upgrade paths, and telemetry. The focus for the quarter is threefold: 1) harmonize onboarding and activation lanes (cohorts, compatibility gates), 2) deliver two cross-tenant governance primitives (consentable audit streams + tenant-scoped RBAC policies), and 3) establish measurable OKRs and telemetry to reduce incident MTTR and upgrade friction. The deliverable is a prioritized sprint-level plan, a launch checklist for first 10 enterprise customers, and an OKR dashboard linked to Console metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding: published cohort activation matrix and 3 readiness-check scripts for compatibility validation (can be run by solutions engineers)
Governance primitives: tenant-scoped RBAC v1 deployed to test cluster and audit-stream config validated with two pilot customers
Upgrade friction: documented upgrade runbook with rollback triggers and automated healthchecks integrated into Console (alerts wired to PagerDuty)
Telemetry: OKR dashboard in Console showing 'upgrade success rate', 'activation time', and 'MTTR' with baselined values for current cohort
Runbook: customer-facing runbook + internal ops checklist complete and linked from the private-deploy onboarding page
tasks: Draft quarterly objectives and KPIs with Eng leads (deadline: 2026-03-08)
Map active private customers into 3 cohorts (lighthouse, mid, self-serve) and draft cohort-specific gating criteria
Define and spec tenant-scoped RBAC v1: roles, permissions matrix, API surface (PRD link)
Work with Runtime team to add upgrade healthchecks and expose signals to Console metrics
Partner with Solutions Eng to create compatibility-check scripts and a CI job that runs before customer activation
Write customer onboarding checklist and prepare 2 pilot onboarding runthroughs (internal dry-run + customer pilot)
Create OKR dashboard template in Console and wire sample metrics from staging cluster
Prepare go/no-go risk checklist and rollback criteria for each tranche
